page.layout: One printed title page, centred on the scan. Faint, mirrored show-through from the reverse side fills the page. Below the title block: a library stamp (excluded), an engraved device, and a printer's imprint in the lower part.
page.notes: The title page is very faint. Most of the visible lines are mirrored show-through from the reverse and are not transcribed. The readings above are only partial and uncertain; the words in brackets are not legible letter by letter. The purple ZURICH "STADTBIBLIOTHEK" stamp is a library stamp and is excluded. The engraving in the middle of the page is not text. The lower lines (a Latin motto in italic, a printer's name and place, and a date) are too faint and mirrored to read reliably, so they are not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
